limitations: Single trials do not establish causation, general equivalence, coding quality, speed or cost trends.
All graded results retain their original measured sources. No paid result measured the integrated PR head.
Original setup used a company cap but left the lead budget at zero. Corrected setup applied both company and lead caps.
Unknown total activity and missing final result/ledger/cleanup for two interrupted jobs remain missing, not silently passed.
Configured model identity is not independent proof of provider-side execution identity.
ACPX provider-execution IDs are not proven mapped to host-call IDs. Never join by name, order or count.
Measurement is an extracted delivery projection; vendor private prompts, tokenization, loading and truncation remain unverified.
Numeric billing subtotals and raw sessions are excluded from this public summary; no complete billing or savings claim is made.
